verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents its own custom reports, with relative date ranges, adding or removing columns, and applying filters. The evidence never says those filters or any grouping can use class, location, or tag dimensions, so only the generic custom-report core of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented filtering by class/location/tag dimensions, documented grouping by those dimensions, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions

citations.quote: custom reports ("changing the relative date range, adding or removing columns, and applying filters")
with custom fields, custom templates, and custom reports
